items.headline: Hayden Wolfe's field goal in OT lifts Troy to 24-21 victory over James Madison
items.description: — Hayden Wolfe kicked a 27-yard field goal in overtime and Troy rallied from a 14-point deficit to beat James Madison 24-21 on Thursday night.
